🗺️ Tiny Mind — Treasure Hunt

your character lives somewhere inside those numbers. find it. prove it.

1 · bring your tiny mind

drop your saved .bin + tok512.bin anywhere, or no model yet

2 · what shall we hunt for?


quick quests:
a good hunt needs a fact that's really about your character: the answer should be one word, and changing the name should change the answer. facts like "lives in a magic tree" are tricky — "magic" alone predicts "tree" for anyone, so there's no character-treasure to find. (step 3 has a button to test this.)

3 · what the model says

4 · the detective's clues — every clue is only a GUESS until you test it

the detective is an AI that guesses where the knowledge might live — it never measures anything. the numbers in step 3 are the tiny model's own; these are just hunches to test.

5 · test anything yourself

const EMBEDDED_BASE_STORIES = ["Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a red ball. She liked to play with it in the park. One day the ball rolled into a puddle. Lily was sad, but her mom helped her wash it. Then Lily was happy again.","Tom had a small dog named Max. Max liked to run and jump. Every morning Tom and Max went for a walk. They saw birds in the trees. Max wagged his tail and Tom laughed. They were good friends.","Ben found a shiny rock by the pond. It was smooth and gray. He wanted to show his mom. He ran home fast. His mom smiled and said it was very pretty. Ben put the rock on his shelf.","Sara and her brother made a cake. They mixed the flour and the eggs. The cake smelled so good. When it was done, they gave a piece to their dad. He said it was the best cake ever. Everyone was happy.","There was a cat named Mia. Mia liked to sleep in the warm sun. One day it started to rain. Mia ran inside and hid under the bed. When the sun came back, she went out to play again.","A little boy named Sam had a blue kite. He took it to the hill on a windy day. The kite went up, up, up into the sky. Sam held the string tight and watched it fly. He was so proud.","Anna wanted to help her grandma in the garden. They planted seeds in the dirt and gave them water. Every day Anna checked the plants. After many days, little green leaves came up. Anna was very glad.","One day a duck went to the pond. She saw a frog on a big green leaf. The frog said hello. The duck and the frog played all day. When the sun went down, they said goodbye and went home.","Timmy lost his teddy bear. He looked under the bed and behind the door. He could not find it. He was very sad. Then his mom found it in the car. Timmy hugged his bear and smiled.","A girl named Lucy had a new dress. It was yellow with white flowers. She wore it to the party. All her friends said it was pretty. Lucy danced and laughed. It was a very fun day.","There was a big tree in the yard. A small bird made a nest in it. Soon there were three little eggs. The mother bird kept them warm. One day the eggs opened and baby birds came out.","Jack and Emma went to the beach. They made a castle in the sand. The waves came and washed it away. But they were not sad. They just made a new castle. They played until it was time to go.","A little mouse was very hungry. He looked for food in the kitchen. He found a piece of cheese under the table. He was so happy. He ate it all up and then went back to his cozy hole.","Molly had a red bike. She wanted to ride it, but she was scared. Her dad held the bike and helped her. Soon Molly could ride all by herself. She felt brave and strong. She rode all around the park.","One morning the sun was bright. A boy named Leo went outside to play. He saw a butterfly with pretty wings. It landed on a flower. Leo watched it very quietly. Then it flew away into the sky.","Sue baked cookies with her mom. They put them on a plate to cool. The cookies were warm and sweet. Sue gave one to her little sister. Her sister smiled and said thank you. They ate them together.","A dog named Rex liked to dig in the yard. One day he dug a big hole. He found an old bone in the dirt. He was so happy. He picked it up and ran to show the other dogs.","There was a little fish in the sea. She liked to swim near the rocks. One day she met a crab. The crab was funny and kind. They swam and played all day. The little fish was not lonely anymore.","Kate had a balloon at the fair. It was big and round and red. She held the string very tight. The wind was strong, but she did not let go. She kept her balloon all the way home.","A boy named Max helped his mom clean the house. He put his toys away in the box. He wiped the table and swept the floor. His mom said he was a big help. (This is the ladder after busted clues.) const layerTotals = {}; for (const h of m.allHeadScores ?? m.headScores) layerTotals[h.layer] = (layerTotals[h.layer] ?? 0) + h.score; const bestLayer = +Object.entries(layerTotals).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])[0][0]; out.push({ kind: 'team', layer: bestLayer, claim: `Maybe no single head holds it — maybe the WHOLE TEAM of layer ${bestLayer}'s attention heads shares the job of looking back at "${name}".`, prediction: `Switch off ALL ${S.config.nHeads} heads in layer ${bestLayer} at once — if the team holds the treasure, the answer should break badly.` }); return out; } function ablationFor(h) { if (h.kind === 'head') return { heads: [`${h.layer}:${h.index}`] }; if (h.kind === 'neuron') return { neurons: [`${h.layer}:${h.index}`] }; return { heads: Array.from({ length: S.config.nHeads }, (_, i) => `${h.layer}:${i}`) }; // team } function labelFor(h) { if (h.kind === 'head') return `head L${h.layer}·H${h.index}`; if (h.kind === 'neuron') return `neuron L${h.layer}·n${h.index}`; return `ALL heads in layer ${h.layer}`; } async function llmHypotheses(m) { const name = $('qName').value.trim(); const evidence = { task: `The tiny language model completes "${$('qProbe').value}" with "${$('qCont').value}" (probability ${m.contProb}).`, character: name, modelShape: S.config, topGuesses: m.top, headAttentionToName_atAnswerPosition: m.headScores, neuronContrast_onNamePieces: m.neuronTop, }; const prompt = `You are a friendly detective helping a child (age 10) discover WHERE a tiny transformer stores its knowledge of an invented character. Study the evidence, then propose EXACTLY 3 falsifiable hypotheses the child can test by switching parts off (ablation). Evidence (JSON): ${JSON.stringify(evidence)} Answer with ONLY a JSON array, no prose: [{"kind":"head"|"neuron","layer":,"index":,"claim":"","prediction":""}]`; const raw = await callLLM({ provider: $('detective').value, key: $('detKey').value.trim(), model: $('detModel').value.trim(), prompt, maxTokens: 1500 }); const jsonText = raw.match(/\[[\s\S]*\]/)?.[0]; const arr = JSON.parse(jsonText); return arr.filter(h => (h.kind === 'head' || h.kind === 'neuron') && Number.isInteger(h.layer) && Number.isInteger(h.index)).slice(0, 3); } $('cluesBtn').onclick = async () => { if (!S.probe) return; $('cluesBtn').disabled = true; $('hypos').innerHTML = '
the detective is thinking…
'; let hypos; try { hypos = $('detective').value === 'builtin' ? heuristicHypotheses(S.probe) : await llmHypotheses(S.probe); } catch (err) { $('hypos').innerHTML = `
${esc(err)} — falling back to the built-in detective
`; hypos = heuristicHypotheses(S.probe); } renderHypos(hypos); $('cluesBtn').disabled = false; speak(kid() ? 'Here are my clues! But careful — clues can lie. Test them!' : 'Hypotheses ready. Each one is falsifiable — test them.'); }; function renderHypos(hypos) { $('hypos').innerHTML = hypos.length ? '' : '
no strong clues found — try testing parts yourself below
'; for (const h of hypos) { const id = 'hy' + (S.hypoSeq++); const d = document.createElement('div'); d.className = 'hypo'; d.innerHTML = `
🕵️ ${esc(h.claim)}
prediction: ${esc(h.prediction)}
`; d.querySelector('button').onclick = (ev) => { ev.target.disabled = true; runTest(id, ablationFor(h), labelFor(h)); }; $('hypos').appendChild(d); } } // ---------- tests + verdicts ---------- function runTest(id, ablation, label) { S.busy = true; status(`switching ${label} off and re-running…`); worker.postMessage({ type: 'test', id, ...ablation, label }); } function verdictOf(ratio) { if (ratio < 0.5) return { cls: 'proved', icon: '🏆', word: 'PROVED', text: 'switching it off badly broke the answer — the treasure really is (partly) here!' }; if (ratio < 0.85) return { cls: 'weak', icon: '🟡', word: 'helps a little', text: 'the answer got a bit weaker — a small part of the treasure.' }; if (ratio <= 1.15) return { cls: 'busted', icon: '❌', word: 'BUSTED', text: 'nothing changed. the pretty picture lied — that part was not the treasure.' }; return { cls: 'busted', icon: '❌', word: 'BUSTED (backwards!)', text: 'the answer got BETTER without it. definitely not the treasure.' }; } function renderVerdict(m) { const ratio = m.contProb / m.baseline; const v = verdictOf(ratio); const line = `${v.icon} ${v.word} — right-answer chance ${pct(m.baseline)} → ${pct(m.contProb)}. ${v.text}`; const el = document.getElementById(m.id); if (el) el.innerHTML = line; else $('diyOut').innerHTML = `

${line}

Keep hunting!') : `${v.word}. ${pct(m.baseline)} to ${pct(m.contProb)}.`); } function renderScore() { $('score').innerHTML = S.tested.length ? `${S.proved} 🏆 proved · ${S.tested.filter(t => t.ratio >= 0.85).length} ❌ busted · ${S.tested.length} tests run` : 'no tests yet — the scoreboard fills as you ablate'; } // ---------- DIY bench ---------- function buildDiy() { for (const [sel, n] of [['diyL', S.config.nLayers], ['diyH', S.config.nHeads], ['diyNL', S.config.nLayers], ['diyTL', S.config.nLayers]]) { const el = $(sel); el.innerHTML = ''; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) el.add(new Option(i, i)); } } $('diyHeadBtn').onclick = () => { if (!S.probe) return; runTest(null, { heads: [`${$('diyL').value}:${$('diyH').value}`] }, `head L${$('diyL').value}·H${$('diyH').value}`); }; $('diyNeuronBtn').onclick = () => { if (!S.probe) return; const j = Math.max(0, Math.min(S.config.hiddenDim - 1, parseInt($('diyN').value) || 0)); runTest(null, { neurons: [`${$('diyNL').value}:${j}`] }, `neuron L${$('diyNL').value}·n${j}`); }; $('diyTeamBtn').onclick = () => { if (!S.probe) return; const l = $('diyTL').value; runTest(null, { heads: Array.from({ length: S.config.nHeads }, (_, i) => `${l}:${i}`) }, `all heads in layer ${l}`); }; status('load a tiny mind to begin the hunt'); window.__tmLoadPair = (ck, tok) => worker.postMessage({ type: 'load', ckptBuf: ck.buf, tokBuf: tok.buf }); if (window.__tmBridge) { document.getElementById('loadZog') && (document.getElementById('loadZog').style.display = 'none'); }
